=== cmavo xo (PA5) ===

==== Proposed Definition ====
Number question. A question word to which the answer is a number.

==== Proposed Tag ====


==== See Also ====
* {ma}

==== Proposed Keywords ====
* what number?
* how many?

==== Usage Examples ====

;xo gerku cu xabju lo zdani be do:''How many dogs live in your house?''

==== Notes ====


==== Issues ====

{{BPFK Section box close}}
{{BPFK Section box open}}
=== cmavo ci'i (PA5) ===

==== Proposed Definition ====
Infinity. When followed by a number, it denotes a transfinite cardinal, such as ℵ<sub>0</sub>. 

==== Proposed Tag ====


==== See Also ====
* {cimni}

==== Proposed Keywords ====
* infinity

==== Usage Examples ====

;ci'i da mulna'usle:''There are infinitely many prime numbers.''

==== Notes ====


==== Issues ====
As multiplication and exponentiation of transfinite ordinals is incompatible with that of cardinals, a new cmavo should be added for a transfinite ordinal, such as ω<sub>0</sub>.

{{BPFK Section box close}}
{{BPFK Section box open}}
=== cmavo ka'o (PA5) ===

==== Proposed Definition ====
''i'', imaginary unit. When followed by a real number, multiplies that number by i. If four real numbers are separated by three ''ka'o'', the number is a quaternion, with the components in the order 1, i, j, k.

==== Proposed Tag ====


==== See Also ====


==== Proposed Keywords ====
* imaginary number
* imaginary i

==== Usage Examples ====
;saclu fi'ure loi lujna'u li paka'opa .iku'i saclu piro loi lujna'u li ni'upaka'opa:''Only half the complex numbers can be represented in base 1+i, but all complex numbers can be represented in base i-1.''

==== Notes ====


==== Issues ====

{{BPFK Section box close}}
{{BPFK Section box open}}
=== cmavo pai (PA5) ===

==== Proposed Definition ====
The mathematical constant Pi (π), the ratio of a circle's circumference to its diameter.

==== Proposed Tag ====


==== See Also ====
* {te'o}

==== Proposed Keywords ====
* pi
* π

==== Usage Examples ====

;li pai du li ji'i ci pi pa vo pa xa:''Pi is approximately equal to 3.1416.''

==== Notes ====


==== Issues ====

{{BPFK Section box close}}
{{BPFK Section box open}}

=== cmavo tu'o (PA5) ===

==== Proposed Definition ====
Null operand. A placeholder digit used in MEX operations that are grammatically binary, but semantically unary.

==== Proposed Tag ====


==== See Also ====
* {zi'o}


==== Proposed Keywords ====
* null operand
* placeholder digit

==== Usage Examples ====

;li fu'a ciboi muboi vu'u du li fu'a reboi tu'o va'a:''3 5 - in reverse polish notation equals the negative of 2''


==== Notes ====
